verdicts.reason: Both fail in the same ways. The photo is shrunk to a small thumbnail jammed against the right edge, and the pink corner triangle now cuts across the model's face. The left half of the canvas is dead black. The three pink bars are offset to the right with uneven gaps (a tight LomoArt–Fashion gap, then a bigger one before Photography), and their tiny text has no clear hierarchy. B is shifted lower, which spreads the empty space slightly more evenly from top to bottom than A's large empty bottom, but neither layout was actually rearranged.
